journaling.title: What is happening right now that makes you feel happy?
Where are you sitting or resting as you notice this happiness?
What small thing just made you smile?
What feels different about this moment compared to earlier today?
How does happiness feel in your body right now?
Do you feel lighter, calmer, warmer, or more relaxed?
What does your face feel like — soft, relaxed, smiling?
How is your breathing in this moment?
If this happiness had a temperature (warm sun, cool breeze), what would it be?
What simple detail is making this moment pleasant?
What is one small thing around you that you appreciate right now?
What everyday comfort are you enjoying in this moment?
What sound around you feels soothing or nice?
What tiny moment today turned out better than expected?
What gentle positive thought is in your mind?
What feels okay or manageable today?
What worry feels a little quieter in this moment?
What are you silently thankful for right now?

journaling.title: What happened that made you feel sad right now?
When did you first notice this feeling today?

Is there a specific thought that keeps coming back?
What feels different about this moment compared to earlier?

How does your face feel tense, tired, teary?
What happens when you take a slow breath right now?
If this sadness had a weight or shape, what would it be?

What feels like it didn’t go the way you hoped?
What do you wish had happened differently?
What feels unfair or difficult right now?
If your sadness could speak, what would it say?
What thought is making this moment harder?
Are you being hard on yourself about something?
What are you worried this sadness means?
What feels uncertain or scary right now?
What do you need to hear in this moment?

journaling.title: What just happened that made your anxiety spike?

What feels uncertain or out of control in this moment?
Where do you feel anxiety in your body right now?
How fast or slow is your breathing right now?
What is the worst-case scenario your mind is imagining?

What is one sound you can hear right now?
What is something you can physically touch near you?
What reminds you that you are safe in this moment?

What decision feels harder than usual today?
Where in your body do you feel tension or heaviness?

What has taken most of your energy recently?
What feels emotionally draining right now?
What are you tired of carrying by yourself?
What would real rest look like for you in this moment?
